properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js is the SHA-1/SHA-224/256/384/512 engine behind @ethersproject/sha2 (and elliptic). Shipped in the production bundle through the ethers import. Used for ECDSA message hashing and wallet operations — not for TLS. SHA-1 is collision-broken classically, which is why the family carries a D rating; the app itself does not choose the digest — the library does.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 is Ethereum's transaction-signing curve — the app's live signature primitive. The dApp (src/components/Home.jsx:12,69-71) signs mint transactions through ethers/MetaMask with ECDSA over secp256k1. Shor-vulnerable; deadline risk class (signatures forged later cannot retroactively break past sessions, but this key's funds are at stake once a CRQC exists). Changeable here only by the Ethereum protocol itself — the app cannot switch curves; migration is ecosystem-governed.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Single-round MD5 key derivation inside the browserify cipher stack of ganache-core (the local Ethereum test chain, pulled via ethereum-waffle). Dev/test tool only — not bundled into the dApp. The weak KDF matters only for ganache's own crypto shims on a throwaway local chain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Password-hashing KDF shipped in the dev tooling dependency tree: sshpk (used by ganache-core/http-signature in hardhat tooling) depends on bcrypt-pbkdf, which depends on tweetnacl. Marked "dev": true — build/runtime app code has no call site for it. bcrypt-pbkdf is PBKDF2 with bcrypt's Blowfish PRF; quantum-relevant only for password-derivation strength (Grover), Shor does not apply. Changeable only by swapping dev tooling, not at an app call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Browserified ECDH primitive inside ganache-core's crypto shim (dev/test tree via ethereum-waffle). Not reachable from the dApp's application code — recorded as dependency presence only. Ecosystem-level PQ migration is irrelevant here since no live key agreement happens with it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 signatures (Shor-vulnerable) available through the shipped dev tree via tweetnacl 0.14.5 — pulled in by bcrypt-pbkdf and sshpk under ganache-core. No app-code call site (the app signs via MetaMask). Presence recorded for the CBOM: the build ships an Ed25519 implementation in dev dependencies; it is observable here and replaceable only by changing the tooling.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4 is the ECDSA-over-secp256k1 implementation behind @ethersproject/signing-key — the exact library that turns an Ethereum private key into a signed transaction. The dApp imports ethers (src/components/Home.jsx:4, WalletBalance.jsx:2) so it ships in the production bundle; the signing happens in MetaMask's provider, but the verifying/key math this library implements is the app's signature primitive. Shor-vulnerable, deadline class; replaceable only ecosystem-wide.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl is pulled by sshpk (X.509/SSH key parsing) via http-signature inside ganache-core's dev tree. crypto_scalarmult (X25519) is its key-agreement half. Dev/test tool only; no application call site — recorded as dependency presence.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 is Ethereum's workhorse hash: transaction hashing, address derivation, keystore-file MACs. Bundled into the production app because src/components/Home.jsx and WalletBalance.jsx import ethers directly. Grover-only impact; not urgent, but it is what the shipped bundle computes with.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 ships in both the app's crypto stack (ethers v5 @ethersproject/pbkdf2 — used for keystore encryption / HD-node derivation) and the dev tooling tree (pbkdf2@^3.0.x via ganache-core / web3 deps, @types/pbkdf2). Password-based KDF: quantum exposure is Grover's quadratic speedup against the underlying password search, not Shor. Iteration counts are not visible in lockfile entries — they live inside the libraries. No direct app call site; consumed inside ethers/ganache when keystores or keys a

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js is the scrypt KDF behind @ethersproject/json-wallets — Ethereum V3 keystore-file encryption (encrypt a private key with a password). Also present under ganache-core (dev tree). The app can reach it via ethers' Wallet encrypt path; parameters (N, r, p) are chosen by the library, not this repo. Memory-hard KDF; Grover-only impact; rating A- is right.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Same tweetnacl@0.14.5 package as the X25519 entry — its secretbox (XSalsa20-Poly1305) authenticated-encryption half. Dev/test tree only via sshpk. Modern symmetric AEAD; quantum impact is Grover-only, so A+ is the right rating; it is recorded because it ships in the installed tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js@3.0.1 is a direct dependency of ethers@5.5.3 — it is the scrypt KDF ethers uses for encrypted JSON keystores. Ships in the build's node_modules whether or not this app opens a keystore; app-side use is absent (signing via MetaMask), so this is availability, not invocation. scrypt is password-hardened and PQ-acceptable (Grover-halved work factor).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha.js@2.4.11 is ethers v5's SHA-2 implementation (SHA-224/256/384/512) used for hashing and keystore MACs/HD-node derivation. Shipped dependency; SHA-2 is post-quantum acceptable. Presence recorded; no direct app call site — app signs via MetaMask.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Duplicate view of the elliptic@6.5.4 dependency already recorded as ALG-710f61f0 (ECDSA via elliptic) — the dependency-scan hit and the algorithm-classification hit on the same package. ECDSA over secp256k1 behind @ethersproject/signing-key, shipped in the app bundle via the ethers import.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.7 is a hashing utility library (SHA-1/2, RIPEMD-160 etc.) shipped as a dependency of elliptic/ethers — RIPEMD-160 matters here as part of legacy Bitcoin-style address derivation paths, and it feeds elliptic's secp256k1 operations. Shipped in the dependency tree; no direct app call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@3.1.1 is the PBKDF2 engine behind @ethersproject/pbkdf2 in the ethers tree — used for Ethereum V3 keystore files (default 262,144 SHA-256 iterations, chosen by the library) and BIP-39 mnemonic-to-seed (2048 iterations by spec). Ships in the app bundle via the ethers import. Iteration counts are library/spec-chosen, not configured by this repo.
